prompt.project_info: Create a realistic university classroom teaching photograph using the attached image for the classroom, chalkboard, and diagram reference only.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult teacher stands beside a large blackboard and gestures while explaining a design or knowledge topic. Use a generic adult teacher with no celebrity or public-figure likeness; no students are required.
prompt.composition_elements: Landscape classroom composition, teacher positioned at the left beside a detailed blackboard, clear chalk diagrams including a hierarchy pyramid, connected circles, numbered principles, and a simple phone-interface sketch, with a dark classroom wall and chalk rail.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft realistic classroom light with gentle highlights on the teacher and legible chalkboard contrast, documentary academic atmosphere, natural room texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic iPhone-style photograph, 16:9 landscape framing, moderate depth of field, natural skin and chalk texture, accurate board geometry, restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic 16:9 university classroom photograph of an original approved adult teacher standing at the left side of a large blackboard and gesturing while explaining a design or knowledge topic. No students are required and the teacher must not resemble any celebrity or public figure. The blackboard contains clear editable chalk diagrams: a hierarchy pyramid, connected circles, numbered principles, and a simple phone-interface sketch. Dark classroom wall, chalk rail, soft realistic classroom light, documentary academic atmosphere, natural skin and chalk texture, iPhone-style photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, recognizable public speaker likeness, unreadable chalk text, random logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

assets.name: classroom blackboard reference
assets.usage: Match the board layout, chalk diagrams, dark wall, chalk rail, framing, and classroom atmosphere; do not use the pictured person's identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required image as an environment-and-board reference only. Chalk wording, logos, typography, and diagrams remain editable.
